music.name: mus_title
music.prompt: Mysterious and wondrous title theme for a fantasy MMORPG: moonlit night, a distant world calling. Soft celesta and harp arpeggios, a lonely bamboo flute melody, warm strings swelling slowly, a viola caipira motif appearing in the middle like a memory of home, gentle wordless choir pad, subtle shimmering bells like falling golden petals. Melancholic but hopeful. Instrumental only, no vocals, loopable, ends on the tonic. Original composition in the spirit of classic 2000s fantasy MMORPG town themes (warm, melodic, memorable), not imitating any existing game.

music.name: mus_city_day
music.prompt: Instrumental cozy town theme for a fantasy MMORPG riverside port town with Brazilian colonial flavor. Viola caipira and acoustic guitar strumming in a relaxed baião-inspired groove, pífano and bamboo flute trading a cheerful modal melody, rabeca countermelody, soft zabumba, triangle and pandeiro, light harp. Warm late afternoon, market bustle, friendly and calm, never intense. No vocals. Loopable, ends on the tonic.

music.name: mus_city_docks

Sparse fingerpicked viola caipira, soft bamboo flute, airy harp, distant rabeca, very light shaker like water ripples, no drums or only a soft pulse. Peaceful, breezy, reflective, golden sunset over the river. No vocals. Loopable, ends on the tonic.

_style: Referência de SENSAÇÃO (nunca copiar, nunca citar jogos nos prompts): efeitos curtos, nítidos e luminosos, estilo MMORPG clássico dos anos 2000 — sinos e carrilhões para recompensas, golpes secos e estalados para combate, monstros com vozes curtas e fofas ou ameaçadoras. Personagens andam em silêncio (passos, se houver, bem discretos). Cada efeito tem 'phase': city (marco atual), f3 (combate), f4 (progressão). Menus e interface NÃO têm som (decisão do dono, 27/09/2026). Cada arma e cada skill têm o próprio som (sfx_weapon_<item>_swing/_hit, sfx_skill_<skill>_cast/_impact); cada monstro tem ataque/dano/morte próprios (sfx_mon_<id>_*).
